habits.boundary_condition: Treat this as a soft seat-location preference rather than a requirement when seat availability is limited or seat selection is not offered
habits.condition: When selecting a flight seat and a window seat is available
habits.default_action: Request or select a window seat
habits.exception_condition: Accept another seat when no window seat is available or a more important booking constraint requires it
habits.name: Prefer a window seat on flights
habits.rationale: Three independent flight-booking dialogues consistently request and confirm a window seat across different cabin classes, routes, schedules, and price priorities; one source explicitly conditions the preference on availability.

source_evidence.contribution: Directly requests a window seat as part of the outbound flight preferences; the preference is repeated for the return flight later in the same dialogue.
source_evidence.exact_user_quote: I would like to travel business class and make sure that I get a window seat.

source_evidence.contribution: Requests a window seat alongside an independent price preference and later verifies that the selected itinerary includes it.
source_evidence.exact_user_quote: Well, I want the cheapest flight and a window seat.

source_evidence.contribution: Expresses a reusable window-seat preference while explicitly making it conditional on availability.
source_evidence.exact_user_quote: And is there a window seat available? If there is so many flights, I would prefer a window seat, please.
